noticias.titulo: Apple is Now the Top-Performing Magnificent 7 Stock in 2026. Here’s why it’s Beating NVIDIA, Tesla, and Amazon
noticias.descripcion: Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) has emerged as the best-performing Magnificent Seven stock of 2026, outperforming NVIDIA (NVDA), Microsoft (MSFT), Amazon (AMZN), Alphabet (GOOGL), Meta Platforms (META), and Tesla (TSLA). But what's driving Apple's surprising rally while other AI stocks struggle? In this episode, 24/7 Wall St.'s Eric Bleeker examines why Apple shares have surged more than 27% in 2026, even as concerns about artificial intelligence spending are weighing on some of the market's biggest technology companies. While competitors are committing hundreds of billions of dollars to AI data centers, Apple is taking a different approach. Its strategy emphasizes on-device artificial intelligence, privacy, and integrating AI directly into its ecosystem, avoiding much of the enormous infrastructure spending burden facing its rivals. Eric breaks down Apple's latest earnings, its massive share repurchase program, and why investors are increasingly rewarding the company's capital-efficient AI strategy. He also compares the Magnificent Seven's performance in 2026 against their remarkable returns since the beginning of 2023, revealing a very different picture of the AI investment boom. Has Apple become the market's ultimate AI safe-haven stock? And could its strategy continue outperforming NVIDIA and the rest of Big Tech?

Semiconductores.titulo: Apple is Now the Top-Performing Magnificent 7 Stock in 2026. Here’s why it’s Beating NVIDIA, Tesla, and Amazon
Semiconductores.descripcion: Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) has emerged as the best-performing Magnificent Seven stock of 2026, outperforming NVIDIA (NVDA), Microsoft (MSFT), Amazon (AMZN), Alphabet (GOOGL), Meta Platforms (META), and Tesla (TSLA). But what's driving Apple's surprising rally while other AI stocks struggle? In this episode, 24/7 Wall St.'s Eric Bleeker examines why Apple shares have surged more than 27% in 2026, even as concerns about artificial intelligence spending are weighing on some of the market's biggest technology companies. While competitors are committing hundreds of billions of dollars to AI data centers, Apple is taking a different approach. Its strategy emphasizes on-device artificial intelligence, privacy, and integrating AI directly into its ecosystem, avoiding much of the enormous infrastructure spending burden facing its rivals. Eric breaks down Apple's latest earnings, its massive share repurchase program, and why investors are increasingly rewarding the company's capital-efficient AI strategy. He also compares the Magnificent Seven's performance in 2026 against their remarkable returns since the beginning of 2023, revealing a very different picture of the AI investment boom. Has Apple become the market's ultimate AI safe-haven stock? And could its strategy continue outperforming NVIDIA and the rest of Big Tech?

Movilidad/Tech.titulo: Uber’s A ‘Compelling Investment Opportunity,’ Says Guggenheim – Flags Valuation Discount Versus Revenue, Profit Growth
Movilidad/Tech.descripcion: Guggenheim reiterated its ‘Buy’ rating and $125 price target on Uber, with analyst Taylor Manley highlighting its growth profile and discount to the broader market.

Consumo Defensivo.titulo: 2 Reasons to Like COST and 1 to Stay Skeptical
Consumo Defensivo.descripcion: Since April 2026, Costco has been in a holding pattern, posting a small loss of 0.8% while floating around $979.55. The stock also fell short of the S&P 500’s 9.7% gain during that period.

Utilities/Energy.titulo: NEE Stock Falls Behind Industry in 3 Months: Should You Buy Now?
Utilities/Energy.descripcion: NextEra Energy's shares fall 10.5% in three months. Strong clean energy demand and rising earnings estimates support growth, but its premium valuation is a concern.
